colors.name: Signal Blue
colors.role: Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Deep Signal
colors.role: Navigation links and brand mark anchors - slightly cooler and more electric than Signal Blue, reserved for chrome-level interaction

colors.name: Signal Sky
colors.role: Hero section wash, large decorative panels - soft periwinkle that bathes the page in brand color without overwhelming

colors.name: Signal Mist
colors.role: Secondary feature panel backgrounds - desaturated teal that recedes behind content, used to break the page rhythm without adding chroma

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Primary body and heading text - soft black at AAA contrast on every surface, the dominant typographic color

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Secondary body text, subdued paragraphs - cool gray with a faint violet cast that echoes the brand blue

colors.name: Twilight
colors.role: Footer background - muted purple-black that grounds the page in a warm dark wash without pure black harshness

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Hairline borders, dividers, footer text - the structural neutral that separates content bands

colors.name: Paper
colors.role: Page canvas - off-white that warms the stark white without going cream

colors.name: White
colors.role: Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: Sole typeface across the entire site. Weight 800 headlines are anti-soft - paired with tight 1.07-1.14 line-heights they create near-solid blocks of type that anchor the page. Weight 600 handles buttons and subheadings with a confident mid-weight. Weight 400 body at 1.50 line-height provides generous reading rhythm. The extreme contrast between 800 display and 400 body is the typographic signature.

fonts.name: system-ui
fonts.role: system-ui - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

components.name: Outlined Primary Action Button
components.role: Primary CTA across the site - used for 'Get Signal', 'Donate to Signal', and most conversion points

components.name: Filled Teal Action Button
components.role: Secondary or contextual action - used sparingly for in-feature prompts like the encrypted message reveal

components.name: Body Paragraph
components.role: Supporting copy under headlines and in feature descriptions

components.name: Hero Phone Mockup Container
components.role: Product visualization in hero and feature sections

components.name: Feature Content Panel
components.role: Right-side visual container in 2-column feature sections

components.name: Encrypted Message Chip
components.role: Decorative element demonstrating the encryption feature

components.name: Halftone Globe Illustration
components.role: Decorative illustration in the nonprofit/donation section

components.name: Footer Link Column
components.role: Organized link groups in the dark footer

components.name: Donate Outlined Button
components.role: Conversion button in the footer illustration section

do: Use Inter weight 800 for all headlines - the extreme weight contrast against 400 body text is the typographic signature
Set line-height to 1.07 for 60px display text and 1.14 for 40px section headings - the tight leading makes headlines feel architectural
Use outlined buttons (1.5px Signal Blue border, white fill) as the default CTA style - filled buttons only when sitting on a colored panel
Apply 8px border-radius to all buttons and 16px to all image/panel containers - the radius gap between interactive and visual elements is intentional
Use Signal Sky (#9dbbf8) for hero washes and Signal Mist (#a5cad5) for secondary panels - alternate the two blue tones to create page rhythm
Set body text line-height to 1.50 - the generous leading is required for the 16px body to feel readable at the page's comfortable density
Limit the brand blue to interactive elements, links, and the halftone illustration - never use it for large decorative fills or backgrounds other than the defined panel washes
doNot: Don't use filled blue buttons on white backgrounds - outlined buttons are the primary CTA pattern and should not be overridden
Don't add gradients, drop shadows beyond the defined elevation token, or decorative borders - the design relies on flat color bands for structure
Don't use colors outside the defined palette - no additional chroma, no warm accents, no status colors beyond the blue family
Don't set headline line-height above 1.20 - loose leading destroys the dense, confident type character
Don't use pill-shaped buttons (9999px radius) - the 8px radius is a deliberate choice that distinguishes Signal from typical consumer apps
Don't add photography, abstract graphics, or illustration styles other than the halftone dot technique - the visual personality is singular
Don't use Inter at weights other than 400, 600, or 800 - 500 and 700 are absent from the type system for a reason; the three-weight gap is the scale
